# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

print(f"Number of rows with revenue 999999.99: {df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]}")

# Check if there are any non-numeric revenue values after removing commas
# First, try to parse revenue as float after removing commas
try:
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    print("Successfully parsed revenue as float.")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error parsing revenue: {e}")"}
